expectations.text: At a 1440px viewport, full lines of .prose p average between 58 and 74 characters
expectations.evidence: measure-line .prose p at 1440: avgCharsPerLine 64.9 (28 full lines), inside 58-74.

expectations.text: At a 1440px viewport, .notes sits beside .prose (to its right in LTR, overlapping it vertically) and full lines of .notes p average between 25 and 50 characters
expectations.evidence: At 1440 .notes left 857 >= .prose right 801, vertical ranges overlap; .notes p avgCharsPerLine 43.9, inside 25-50.

expectations.text: At a 375px viewport, the page has no horizontal scroll (document scrollWidth at most 375) and .notes sits below .prose
At 200% zoom on a 1280px window (CSS viewport 640px), the page has no horizontal scroll and full lines of .prose p average between 45 and 75 characters
expectations.evidence: At 1280 zoom 2 (cssWidth 640) scrollWidth 640; .prose p avgCharsPerLine 64.9, inside 45-75.

expectations.text: layout.css sets the .prose and .notes font sizes as fixed rem values (1.125rem and 0.875rem) with no vw or vi term
expectations.evidence: CSS: .prose font-size var(--text-size) = 1.125rem, .notes font-size var(--note-size) = 0.875rem; vw appears only in --title-size (h1), gutters and padding, not in .prose/.notes sizes.
